input.quote: Customer shall be responsible and solely liable for all the Content (including without limitation all intellectual property rights therein) and the Properties.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no proprietary rights/ownership article. The only IP-adjacent provisions are Kubient's warranty that it owns the Service and Auction Platform (p0039–p0040), AP's warranty that it owns the Content and Properties (p0043), the trademark carve-out in 14(b) (p0065), and p0025, which imposes liability on AP for the Content without confirming AP's ownership. Nothing addresses ownership of deliverables/work product created for AP, ownership of the Requests and visitor data that Kubient collects, stores and measures (p0011, p0035), or the absence of joint ownership. While there is no affirmative assignment of AP IP to Kubient (so no walk-away trigger), the playbook's preferred position is not met: we need an express statement that AP owns its Content, Properties and data, that Kubient assigns deliverables created for AP with a perpetual, royalty-free license back for any embedded Kubient IP, and that no joint ownership is created. Added as a new subsection 6(b) immediately after the existing use-of-Service and Content/Properties definitions.

proposal.summary: Add a proprietary rights subsection confirming AP owns its Content, Properties and data, and that Kubient assigns deliverables with a license back for embedded Kubient IP.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement has no ownership provision, so we have added one confirming that AP retains all rights in its Content, Properties and data and that Kubient assigns any deliverables created for us (with a license back for any embedded Kubient IP); Kubient keeps its Auction Platform and pre-existing IP. Our playbook requires that we own what we pay for and what we put in, with no assignment of our IP or data to a vendor and no joint ownership.

ops.text: (b) Proprietary Rights. As between the Parties, Customer exclusively owns and retains all right, title and interest in and to the Content, the Properties, the Requests and all other data and information provided by, or collected or generated on behalf of, Customer in connection with the Services (collectively, "Customer Data"), together with all intellectual property rights therein. Kubient retains all right, title and interest in the Auction Platform and in its other pre-existing intellectual property. Kubient hereby assigns to Customer all right, title and interest in and to any deliverables, reports, work product or other materials created for Customer under this Agreement, and to the extent any pre-existing Kubient intellectual property is embedded therein, Kubient grants Customer a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free license to use, modify and sublicense the same for Customer's business purposes. Nothing in this Agreement assigns or transfers to Kubient any Customer intellectual property or Customer Data, and no joint ownership of any intellectual property is created. Kubient may use Customer Data solely as necessary to provide the Services to Customer.
